question: Who among the following is the first ever Grammy award winner from India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pt Ravi Shankar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **
**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ravi Shankar** was the very first Indian to win the Grammy Award in 1968. He won for the album named “West Meets East” in the category of “Best Chamber Music Performance”.​
 
• The legendary artist won the first Grammy for his album West Meets East in the 'Best Chamber Music Performance category** in 1968.**
 
• He performed with Anoushka for the **BBC in 1997** at the Symphony Hall in **Birmingham, England.**
 
• “As one of the world's most renowned sitar players, three-time Grammy winner** Ravi Shankar** is a true ambassador for international music,” said a statement issued by the Recording Academy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia** is an Indian music director and classical flautist, who plays the flute, in the Hindustani classical tradition.
 
• Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia is regarded as the best flute player of Eastern Classical music.
 
• **Zakir Hussain has carried on that tradition — not only as one of the world's foremost Indian percussionists but also as one of the architects of modern world music.**
 
• **Pandit Shivkumar** Sharma** **is an Indian music composer and santoor player from the state of **Jammu and Kashmir.**
